subject.title: feat(feeds): search and follow signed publisher feeds

question: Should OpenClaw core own a persistent signed-publisher-feed consumer and `openclaw publisher` CLI, or should this workflow ship as a ClawHub plugin using existing marketplace/plugin seams?
rationale: The proposed implementation adds a durable core command, remote trust boundary, and shared-state records; repository policy prefers optional service workflows outside core when current extension seams are sufficient.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core feed API
options.body: Keep a minimal generic core trust/transport seam only if maintainers identify a concrete missing extension API, then require live producer-to-consumer and upgrade proof.

options.title: Route the consumer to ClawHub
options.body: Move search, follow, and publisher-specific state/UI behavior into a ClawHub plugin and keep core free of publisher-service policy.

recommendation.title: Route the consumer to ClawHub
recommendation.body: Move search, follow, and publisher-specific state/UI behavior into a ClawHub plugin and keep core free of publisher-service policy.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available feed-stack routing contact, though final core-scope approval requires a repository decision owner.
